title: Inventory supervisor semantic types and datasets imports

classification_rules.operational: Supervisor-owned scheduling, isolation, resource, workflow, storage, or daemon concern that uses datasets as a backend or optional surface without redefining logic-family meaning.
classification_rules.compatibility: Alias, spelling, or retained name that preserves an older public surface without adding independent semantic authority.
classification_rules.duplicate: Supervisor-local type that redefines or parallel-owns a logic semantic vocabulary datasets is intended to own (family, property, form, translation, evidence, verdict, assurance, cache-scope axes).
classification_rules.canonical projection: Import or adapter that loads datasets contracts and projects supervisor values onto them, or consumes datasets types as the authority without inventing a second semantic registry.

scope_notes: Direct imports are AST-level `from/import ipfs_datasets_py...` statements plus explicit lazy importlib targets that load datasets modules at call time.
String references used only for path scope, documentation provenance, git ls-tree probes, or env var names are not counted as imports.

Homonymous enums that do not redefine logic-platform axes (for example repository surface EvidenceKind) are inventoried only when they share a name with a logic semantic type and could be mistaken for one.
ipfs_datasets_py is empty in this worktree; classifications use supervisor source as authority and the plan ownership split (datasets owns semantics; supervisor owns operations).
